title: CXCA.S2.DT Determine whether cervical cancer screening is due (CQL)
description: The S2 decision table evaluated as REAL CQL: CXCADueForScreeningLogic (near-verbatim from the DAK) includes the S1 eligibility library, and each dynamicValue expression carries Expression.reference — the Library canonical — so the evaluator addresses the right library. The first multi-library table on the KMP stack.
